result.summary: Verdict FINDINGS at target d428e0f730ed5649485732e95d39c32f5d6a8895. Scope: client HTTP/MCP connection/error/close, token redaction, URL output, noninteractive JSON. Two MEDIUM defects, both reproduced with local fakes. (1) src/cli/client.ts:88 + src/cli/tui.ts:56: overview() returns the raw endpoint; src/cli.ts:160 scrubs data.url once, but the dashboard refresh() replaces the whole object, so the TUI re-prints the unredacted endpoint (e.g. ?token=[REDACTED] from the first 5s poll. Reproduced via a real pty run of `swarmforge status`. (2) src/cli/tui.ts:77/93/111: dashboard refresh/inspect/control errors are caught in runDashboard and rendered via safeTerminalText, which strips control chars but does no credential redaction, so the scrub at src/cli.ts:184-186 is bypassed and an echoed bearer reaches the terminal. Close-on-error, pagination guard, JSON output and server auth verified correct. Artifacts: .swarmforge/artifacts/review.md, findings.json. /workspace/repo clean at 5672ead.
result.details:
Target verified with git rev-parse HEAD in a disposable detached clone at /tmp/rev40/repo. Tests executed with Bun 1.4.2 unpacked to /tmp/rev40/bun142 (system bun 1.3.14 cannot read this lockfile; lockfile never rewritten): bun install --frozen-lockfile exit 0; bun test tests/cli.test.ts tests/overview.test.ts tests/http.test.ts exit 0 (14 pass, 0 fail, 65 expect); bun test tests/commands.test.ts exit 0 (15 pass, 0 fail, 223 expect). Probes (all outside the source checkout, disclosed): /tmp/rev40/probe/tui-url.ts reproduced finding 1 with the real HTTP handler, real client and real dashboard; /tmp/rev40/probe/pty-e2e.ts reproduced finding 1 end-to-end through `bun src/cli.ts status` under a pty past the 5s poll; /tmp/rev40/probe/tui-error.ts reproduced finding 2; /tmp/rev40/probe/transport-error.ts confirmed a real StreamableHTTPClientTransport error carries an echoed bearer; /tmp/rev40/probe/overview-escape.ts found no injectable field in the non-escaped header lines of renderOverview. /tmp/rev40/probe/live-call-error.ts exited 1 and is inconclusive (the ad-hoc stub did not satisfy the MCP handshake); it is superseded by transport-error.ts and is not claimed as evidence.

Why existing guards do not prevent finding 1: the redaction regression test at tests/commands.test.ts:987-1055 exercises only --json and --no-interactive, and the dashboard is gated on process.stdin.isTTY && process.stdout.isTTY (src/cli.ts:163-166), which those tests never create. tests/overview.test.ts:285-333 drives runDashboard with a fixed data.url and a stub client returning the same object, so a refresh cannot change the URL.

Why existing guards do not prevent finding 2: tests/commands.test.ts:909 asserts only on stderr for the noninteractive path; in interactive mode the error never becomes an exception out of showStatus, so the scrub is bypassed by construction. Server-side redaction (src/mcp.ts:59-63) does not apply because the echo arrives in an HTTP status body, outside any tool-result redactor.

Verified-correct areas: client.close() runs in a finally (src/cli.ts:175-179) so a refused connection or failed overview still tears down the transport; the overview pagination loop rejects a non-advancing next_offset (src/cli/client.ts:82-85) and is exercised with 101 workers; --json emits exactly one line of JSON, exits 0 on success and 1 with empty stdout and scrubbed stderr on failure, and --no-interactive emits a plain snapshot with no ANSI; server bearer comparison is timing-safe with a length pre-check, origin equality and host allowlist (src/http.ts:9-32).

Limitations: the dashboard is TTY-gated, so reproductions used a real pty or the same fake-stdin/stdout EventEmitter pattern the repository's own overview tests use; all probes used tests/helpers.ts fake provider/agent and a loopback Bun.serve handler with no real cloud or model provider contacted; finding 2's trigger depends on a server or intermediary echoing Authorization, whose reachability is confirmed at the client boundary but whose concrete deployment is environment-dependent; the full suite was not run because that is the whole-suite reviewer's scope. All probe credential values are synthetic.

result.followup_reason: Two actionable MEDIUM defects in the client's interactive surfaces, both reproduced: (1) src/cli/client.ts:88 + src/cli/tui.ts:56 let runDashboard's refresh() discard the endpoint redaction applied at src/cli.ts:160, so the unredacted endpoint (potentially carrying ?token= or userinfo) is printed from the first poll; (2) src/cli/tui.ts:77/93/111 render refresh/inspect/control error text through safeTerminalText without credential redaction, bypassing the scrub at src/cli.ts:184-186 and allowing an echoed Authorization bearer to reach the terminal.
